items.title: ‘Iron Man’ Cinematographer Matthew Libatique Says AI ‘Could Replace Marvel’ VFX, but They’ll Never ‘Use AI Actors’
items.excerpt: Cinematographer Matthew Libatique says he is testing AI tools for Darren Aronofsky's next project and that AI 'could replace' Marvel-style VFX work, while insisting studios will never use AI actors.

items.title: ‘Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom’ Director on Why AI Is Not a Threat: ‘There’s a Desire to See the Craft Behind the Finished Product’
items.excerpt: 'Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom' co-director Matthew Walker explains why he doesn't see generative AI as a threat to Aardman-style stop-motion: audiences want to see the craft.

items.title: AI Vocal Modifier Voicemod Inks Disney Deal to Add Star Wars, Marvel Soundboards to Platform
items.excerpt: AI voice-modifier platform Voicemod signed a Disney licensing deal to add official Star Wars and Marvel character voices and sound effects for creators and gamers.

items.title: AI Dubbing Pioneer Flawless Sells Tech To Steven Schuurman Venture
items.excerpt: Flawless, the British company that spent $100M building SAG-AFTRA-endorsed AI visual-dubbing (TrueSync) used on films like 'Fall', has sold its technology IP to a venture led by Steven Schuurman, raising questions about the tool's future.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA, WGA & AFM Warn Of "Harms" Of Unlicensed AI Training
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA, the WGA and the AFM filed a brief asking a federal judge to reject a fair-use exemption for AI training in the OpenAI copyright case, warning of the 'harms of unlicensed training' for performers and writers.

items.title: Ava DuVernay Defends Using AI in New Doc ’14th’
items.excerpt: Ava DuVernay defends using AI to animate archival photographs in her new documentary, saying audiences should make their own decisions about the technology.

items.title: Tokyo: TIFFCOM Market Chief On Riding the Japanese IP Wave as Entertainment Landscape Shifts Due to AI
items.excerpt: TIFFCOM managing director Kaori Ikeda on how AI is reshaping the entertainment landscape as Japan pushes its IP beyond anime and manga.

items.title: View Conference’s AI Sales Pitches Were Exhausting
items.excerpt: At Turin's View Conference, filmmakers shared hand-crafted animation work while AI evangelists pitched generative tools and insisted everyone already uses them; Cartoon Brew calls the sales pitches exhausting and occasionally misleading.

items.title: The NEW Lighting Workflow Changing Filmmaking (Full AI Tutorial)
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge walks through a new AI relighting workflow for film footage, showing how generative tools can re-light shots in post.

items.title: Google’s next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences
items.excerpt: Google announced Genie 4, a world model that generates more realistic interactive environments with accompanying audio; Google pitches it for filmmaker pre-visualization, launching first as a research preview for trusted testers.

items.title: "3분 액션신에 2억 절감"…AI로 제작비 아끼고 창작 영역 확장
items.excerpt: [AI 만난 방송가 ②] 생성형 AI가 자막·음성 변환을 넘어 액션신·CG 제작에 쓰이며 3분 액션신에서 2억 원을 절감하는 등 국내 드라마·예능 제작비와 창작 영역을 바꾸고 있다.

items.title: 방송가 파고든 AI, 일자리 감소·저작권 침해 우려도…공존 해법은
items.excerpt: [AI 만난 방송가 ③] 방송 제작 현장에 AI가 빠르게 확산하면서 일자리 감소와 저작권 침해 우려가 커지고, 업계는 공존 해법을 모색하고 있다.

items.title: After Effects Portal October 2026
items.excerpt: Rich Young's monthly After Effects roundup for October 2026 covers new features, AI-driven tools and third-party plugins for motion and VFX artists.

items.title: Adobe MAX 2026 preview: keynotes and Sneaks
items.excerpt: Preview of Adobe MAX 2026 (Nov 10-12, Miami Beach): keynote times, Sneaks and the video and audio sessions to watch as Adobe rolls out its next Firefly and Premiere AI features.

items.title: From AI generation to final cut, Fotor Agent takes on the video production workflow · TechNode
items.excerpt: Fotor Agent aims to move AI video beyond single impressive clips by handling the full workflow from generation to final cut.

items.title: ByteDance Is Rewiring Its AI Video Bet · TechNode
items.excerpt: ByteDance's CapCut unit folded its Xiaoyunque AI video product into Jimeng, consolidating its AI video creation tools for creators.

items.title: China’s AI microdrama boom joins a global surge in mobile viewing · TechNode
items.excerpt: Tencent's new WeChat short-drama service Lupaopao offers AI-generated series alongside live-action and animated shows, part of China's AI microdrama boom.
